in_sanskrit.name: Keshansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Horse Sun
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Keshansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kesha' meaning horse and 'Ansh' meaning sun. This name signifies the power and strength of the sun, represented by a horse.

in_hindi.name: Keshansh
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Horse Sun

in_tamil.name: Keshansh
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Horse Sun
in_tamil.long_meaning: Keshansh ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kesha' meaning horse and 'Ansh' meaning sun. This name signifies the power and strength of the sun, represented by a horse.

in_telugu.name: Keshansh
in_telugu.long_meaning: Keshansh ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kesha' meaning horse and 'Ansh' meaning sun. This name signifies the power and strength of the sun, represented by a horse.

in_marathi.name: Keshansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Keshansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kesha' meaning horse and 'Ansh' meaning sun. This name signifies the power and strength of the sun, represented by a horse.

in_bengali.name: Keshansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Horse Sun
in_bengali.long_meaning: Keshansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kesha' meaning horse and 'Ansh' meaning sun. This name signifies the power and strength of the sun, represented by a horse.
